semantics.reset: Asynchronous active-high areset: posedge areset clears q immediately; asserted reset also overrides all clocked operations.
semantics.update: At posedge clk when reset is low: load=1 copies data; else ena=1 shifts right one bit; else q holds.
semantics.sampling: load, ena and data sampled on rising clock edge; no changes between clock edges except reset assertion.
semantics.initialization: No specified power-up value before reset or load; no initial assignment.
semantics.reset_release: Deasserting reset alone does not change q.

numeric.shift: Logical right shift: next q[3]=0, next q[2:0]=old q[3:1]; old q[0] discarded.
numeric.load: Exact 4-bit copy; no arithmetic, saturation or rounding.

verification.oracle: Independent integer model: load copies data; shift uses integer division by two; disabled holds; reset clears.
coverage: All 16 prior values x all 4 load/ena combinations x all 16 data values
Asynchronous reset between rising edges, including asserted load and ena
Reset release without a clock edge
Input changes without a rising edge
verification.comparison: Case inequality after nonblocking assignments settle; fatal on mismatch.
verification.bounds: Finite shell compile/simulation timeouts and testbench watchdog.
verification.scope: Own development testbench only; no official evaluation, synthesis or board work.

specification_ambiguities: Power-up contents before reset/load are unspecified; tests first assert reset.
